Integrating four ordered oscillator kernels e^{-as}sin(bs)/b (24 orders) gives the 16-signed-gap rational sum; independently reconstructed this expression and exactly matched its rational formula against six positive rational triples using SymPy. The denominator is positive, C0,C1>0 and C2=12a²-30ad-27d² changes sign at a/d=(5+sqrt(61))/4; concave quadratic in b² then has exactly one positive root when C2<0. Matched full output covariance and Gaussian-thermal fourth-cumulant cancellation follow from linear filtering. Six checks are corroboration rather than a universal symbolic simplification certificate.
